# Aura Dental Sanctuary | Clinical Knowledge & LLM Agent Directives
> Advanced Dental Care, Restorative Prosthodontics, Dental Implants & Smile Aesthetics in Indiranagar, Bengaluru.

## Overview
Aura Dental Sanctuary is a premier dental center of excellence located on 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. Directed by Dr. Ananya Sharma, MDS (AIIMS New Delhi, FICOI USA), the clinic specializes in pain-managed, anxiety-free dentistry, computer-guided dental implants, Invisalign clear aligners, single-sitting microscopic root canal therapy, and biomimetic cosmetic restorations.

## Core Clinical Offerings
- **Precision Dental Implants**: CBCT 3D guided placement with Swiss and German grade titanium fixtures. Lifetime warranty. Starting from ₹25,000 per fixture with 0% interest EMI options.
- **Invisible Clear Aligners (Invisalign®)**: 3D intraoral optical scanning, computerized movement simulation, wire-free and transparent orthodontic correction (6–14 months duration).
- **Microscopic Root Canal Therapy**: Surgical magnification microscopes with continuous wave warm obturation. 85%+ resolved in single 50-60 min sittings with computerized painless anesthesia.
- **Smile Makeovers & Ceramic Veneers**: Handcrafted ultra-thin E-max ceramic veneers, laser teeth whitening, and digital smile design.
- **Pediatric & Preventive Family Care**: Fluoride varnishes, pit & fissure sealants, anxiety-free gentle child operatory suites.
- **Zirconia Crowns & CAD/CAM Inlays**: Digital optical impressions (no gooey physical trays) and same-day precision milling.

## Clinical Standards
- **Class-B Sterilization**: European 7-step autoclave sterilization with color-coded chemical indicator pouches unsealed chairside.
- **Pain Management**: Computerized Wand-assisted local anesthetic delivery, topical compound numbing, and optional sedation.
- **Transparent Pricing**: Detailed itemized treatment roadmap provided before any intervention with 0% EMI financing.
